rationale.campaign_length: 结构化库定位156项B32直接任务定义；额外15项B61龙之子内战任务不能相加为单局B32数量。
rationale.colonization: 主线主要是旧疆域的征服与整合，远方开拓不是核心殖民循环。
rationale.complexity: 形成门槛、试炼、显贵、自治领、继承战争和局势分支同时存在。
rationale.dark_story: 地精与豺狼人的跨地区驱逐、荒废和人口变现是当前任务明确的黑暗面。
rationale.difficulty: 前传与试炼、后期多地区建设和征服可能显著拖长战役；未实机测量。
rationale.diplomacy: 显贵阶层、自治领、附庸和继承战争要求管理帝国内部关系。
rationale.early_pressure: 压力主要属于形成前的东坎诺统一与资格准备；B32形成后的力量未实机测评。
rationale.magic_artifice_intensity: 试炼、龙锻炉与后期奇械并存，军事与历史复兴仍更核心。
rationale.narrative_density: 古帝国兴亡、形成试炼、军团复兴、继承危机与人之乡目标组成超长叙事。
rationale.tall_play: 卡斯托纳斯、古城墙、城堡、军团道路、农业和工业设施设大量建设目标。
rationale.trade_economy: 道路、城堡、城市工业与奇械工坊提供经济维度，贸易不是唯一发动机。
rationale.warfare: 从东坎诺统一到古帝国各地区的扩张，军团与战争持续推进主线。

description.text:
「卡斯塔诺的人们，当建立帝国的卡斯塔诺人跋涉一万里逃离布勒瓦尔的奴隶制和混乱时，你们的勇气今天怎么能丧失呢？两千多年前，在「先祖」卡斯坦的带领下，他们选择了战斗并光荣地死去而不是等待恶魔之火在他们坚固的山上蔓延时，你们的勇气怎么能丧失呢？冲下山坡，穿过火海，与一个人数比你多十倍的敌人战斗，这是勇敢的最后一步……但卡斯特罗斯看到了不同的情况。卡斯坦冲锋时，卡斯特罗斯做了什么？他以银龙的形式出现，把恶魔的火焰吹回豺狼人身上，一锤定音地改变了人类的命运！

卡斯塔诺的人，勇敢点，你们的手臂不会让你们失望的！卡斯塔诺的战士们，高举你们的剑，我们以卡斯塔诺的名义冲锋，为了燃山之战！让诸神听到我们的呐喊，因为他们会以胜利回应！」
description.text_en:
'Men of Castanor, how can your courage fail you today when the Castanites who founded this Empire walked ten thousand miles to flee slavery and chaos in Bulwar? How can your boldness fail you when two thousands years ago, led by Castan the Progenitor, they chose to fight and die with honour rather than to wait and die by the gnollish demonflame creeping up their fortified hill? To charge downhill, through fire and flame, and to clash with a foe that outnumbered you ten to one, was to be the last act of bravery... but Castellos saw otherwise. And during the Castanite charge, what did Castellos do? He appeared in the form of a Silver Dragon and blew the demonflame back at the gnolls, decisively altering the fate of mankind!

'Men of Castanor, be bold, for your arms will not fail you! Men of Castanor, hold your swords high, for we charge in the name of Castan and the Battle of the Burning Hill! And let our battlecry be heard by the gods, for they will answer with victory!'

name.text_en: The Battle of the Burning Hill

description.text: 达梅纳斯、维特斯克、沼泽堡、南界堡……这些城市和要塞的古卡斯塔诺名称至今仍显示出大卡斯塔帝国过去的疆域。我们永远不会忘记卡斯塔诺是第一个统治这片土地的人类帝国，我们的义务，不，神圣的职责就是把他们带回我们的领地，只有当我们统治了整个坎诺，这片土地才能安全。
description.text_en: Damenath, Vertesk, Bal Mire, Bal Ouord... The old Castanorian name of those cities and fortresses still today show the extent of the Greater Castan's Empire of the past. We will never forget that Castanor was the first human empire to rule these lands, and it is our sovereign, no, holy duty to take them back into the fold - for only when we rule all of Cannor can the lands be safe.

description.text: 与坎诺的其他城市不同的是，卡斯托纳斯是按照矮人们的蛇脊城堡建造的。就像最伟大的矮人所拥有的一样，它看起来不像是一座城市，而是整个国家都集中在巨大的城墙之内。东坎诺的所有民族都汇聚于此，没有商人可以不经过石之城的庞大市场就能在这里运输货物。因为和东坎诺做生意就是和卡斯托纳斯做生意。
description.text_en: Unlike all other cities in Cannor, Castonath was modelled after the dwarven holds of the Serpentspine. And like the greatest dwarven holds, it seems like rather than a city, an entire country was concentrated inside huge walls. All peoples of Escann is represented here, and no merchant can transport goods across Escann without making a stop at the sprawling markets of the City of Stone. For to trade with Escann is to trade with Castonath.

name.text: 卡斯托纳斯即东坎诺，东坎诺即卡斯托纳斯
name.text_en: Castonath is Escann, and Escann is Castonath

description.text: 卡斯塔诺早期成功地将自己建立为一个强大而持久的力量，很大程度上归功于一个矮人：「建筑师」巴尔加尔。他无与伦比的建筑技术为坎诺建造了许多前所未见的伟大建筑，从传说中的为卡斯坦军团提供武器的龙锻炉，到保护羽翼未丰的帝国免受巨大威胁的白墙，再到现在散布在坎诺各处的著名城堡。
description.text_en: Castanor's early successes at establishing itself as a great, lasting power was largely due to one dwarf: Balgar the Builder. His unparalleled mastery of architecture allowed for the construction for great works unseen in Cannor, from the legendary Dragonforge that armed the Castanorian Legions, to the White Walls that protected the fledgling empire from monstrous threats, to the famous citadels now scattered across Cannor.

description.text: 卡斯塔诺军团是卡斯塔诺权力的源泉，他们曾在坎诺、布勒瓦尔和萨拉哈德行军，以确保帝国的权力。虽然古代的日子早已过去，但我们可以照旧改革军队结构，建立一支真正适合帝国的军队。
description.text_en: The Castanorian Legions was the source of Castanor's power, and once marched across Cannor, Bulwar and the Salahad to ensure the empire's power. While the days of antiquity are long gone, we can reform our army structure to follow the old ways, and create an army truly fit for an empire.

description.text:
「黑龙扎玛洛特在夜幕的掩护下飞了起来，把卡斯托纳斯化为灰烬。我所能看到的只有燃烧着的尸体和房屋，在闪烁的火焰中，我看到就连这座城市的白色石头也在黑龙的喷火下变成了黑色。然后，天空中出现了一道闪电，接着是一声震耳欲聋但奇怪而又悦耳的雷声。卡斯塔诺的银龙，传说中卡斯特罗斯的化身，曾在燃山帮助过卡斯坦一世，现在又来帮助我们了——并开始与扎玛洛特战斗。

我本能地跪在那闪闪发光的掠影前，惊叹于它的力量和美丽。这一次，看到龙火让我充满了希望，火焰映在它的鳞片上，如此明亮，一时间似乎黎明已经来临。龙醒事件结束两年后，我仍然因这段记忆而感到幸福。我们所有的人都应该感到庆幸，因为在历史上卡斯特罗斯曾两次以银龙的形式出现，把卡斯塔诺从可怕的结局中拯救出来。」

——《「重建者」卡斯坦三十七世自传》
description.text_en:
'Zaamalot the Black flew under the cover of night, burning Castonath to ash. All I could see were corpses and houses set ablaze, and in the flickers of flame I saw that even the white stone of the city had turned black under the Black Dragon's fiery breath. And then came down the sky what looked like a lighting, followed by a deafening but oddly musical roar of thunder. The Silver Dragon of Castanor, the legendary Avatar of Castellos, who helped Castan I at Burning Hill, was coming to our help again - and began to fight with Zaamalot.

'I knelt before the glistening silhouette instinctively, amazed at the creature's might and beauty. For once, the sight of dragonfire filled me with hope, and the flames reflected on his scales, shining so brightly that it seemed dawn had come for a moment. Two years after the end of the Dragonwake, I still feel blessed by this memory. All of our people should feel blessed that twice in history, Castellos himself appeared in the form of the Silver Dragon to save Castanor from a horrible end.'

-Autobiography of Castan XXXVII the Rebuilder

description.text:
令人遗憾的是，在绿潮之后的冒险者们找到的所有文物中，古老的卡斯塔诺银王冠仍然下落不明。因此，当卡斯塔诺在灰烬中重建时，所有人都清楚，新的卡斯塔诺缺少一个合适的王冠。从今天开始，就不再是这样了。

在一年的工作中，我们最好的铁匠用白银和秘银锻造了一个巨大的宏伟的王冠。在王冠基部，闪耀着，是雕刻描绘白墙的圆环。圆环上每座塔都是卡纳诺万神殿的神像，上面镶着无数的珠宝。在中央，通过金属带连接到墙的内部，是试炼山的一个惊人准确的表现，顶部是一个巨大的钻石！

但这还不是全部，因为在这个杰作中实际上有两个不同的部分！我们的铁匠锻造了一条壮丽的微型龙，而我们王国最有才华的惑控法师在这两部分之间创造了一个无形的魔法连接，这样龙就可以悬浮在王冠上！卡斯塔诺的强大银龙在卡斯坦说话的时候在他的头上展开它的翅膀，这真是一个值得一看的景象。
description.text_en:
It truly is a pity that of all the artifacts recovered by the adventurers after the Greentide, the old silver crown of Castanor is still missing. Hence, when Castanor was rebuilt from its ashes, it was clear to all that the new Castan lacked a fitting crown. From today on, this will not be the case.

Out of silver and mithril, in one year of work, our best smiths forged a huge majestic crown. At the base, shining brightly, is a circlet sculpted to depict the White Walls. Surmounting each tower of the circlet are statues of the gods of the Cannorian Pantheon, encrusted with innumerable jewels. At the center, linked to the interior of the wall by bands of metal, lies an astonishingly accurate representation of Trialmount, topped with a huge diamond!

But that is not all, as there are actually two different parts in this masterpiece! Our smiths forged a splendid miniature dragon, and the most talented enchanter of our realm created an invisible magic link between the two parts, so that the dragon can levitate atop the crown! The mighty Silver Dragon of Castanor deploying its wings around Castan's head as he speaks is truly a sight to behold.

description.text: 蓝宝石之眼骑士团是绿潮之前的骑士团，致力于骑士的美德和维护东坎诺的和平，通过决斗或竞赛来解决东坎诺领地之间的争端，这被称为「骑士审判」。随着我们王国的重生，这个组织从几近毁灭的状态中回来支持我们将和平带回东坎诺。这不仅可以让我们的骑士在一些最伟大的绿潮老兵手下训练，也向世界展示了我们要求的美德和宣称的有效性！
description.text_en: The Order of the Sapphire Eye was a pre-Greentide knightly order devoted to chivalric virtues and maintaining the peace in Escann, fighting in duels or tourneys known as the 'Trials of Chivalry' as a more peaceful alternative to settle disputes between the Escanni realms. With the rebirth of our kingdom, this order has returned from its near-annihilation to offer us their support in bringing peace back to Escann. Not only does this let our knights train under some of the greatest veterans of the Greentide, it also shows the world the virtue and validity of our claims!

description.text: 在术士王之战后，卡斯塔诺被分裂成不同的王国，其中最大的王国是卡斯特王国和阿诺尔王国。最终，他们被统一为一个王国——卡斯泰利尔，卡斯塔诺的合法继承者。我们显然是这一遗产的继承者，也取得了同样的成就。
description.text_en: After the War of the Sorcerer-King, Castanor was broken into disparate realms, some of the greatest of which were the Kingdom of Cast and the Kingdom of Anor. Eventually, these were united under one kingdom - Castellyr, the rightful successor to Castanor. We are the obvious inheritors of this legacy, having accomplished the same.

description.text: 我们为东坎诺带来和平的雄心甚至受到了我们的敌人的尊重，甚至更多地受到了我们被打败的敌人的尊重，他们常常因为被同化为同胞而不是作为敌人被征服而感到惊讶。这使得招募当地合作者和巩固我们对新土地的控制更加容易。
description.text_en: Our ambition to bring peace once again to Escann are respected even by our enemies, and even more by our defeated enemies who are often surprised by being integrated as countrymen rather than subjugated as enemies. This makes recruiting local collaborators and solidifying our control over new lands much easier.

description.text: 我们的许多东坎诺同胞在「绿潮」期间作为难民逃往西方，现在正返回我们所平复的土地。许多人也回到了冒险者王国宣称拥有的土地。这使得同化冒险者变得更容易，因为我们可以简单地用土著邻居包围他们，让基本的社会化来完成工作。
description.text_en: Many of our fellow Escanni fled west as refugees during the Greentide and are now returning to those lands we have pacified. Many have also returned to those lands claimed by the adventurer kingdoms. This makes assimilating the adventurer much easier, as we can simply surround them with native neighbors and let basic socialization do the work.

description.text: 随着政府恢复稳定，骑士精神又回来了。虽然不像绿潮之前那么理想主义，但我们的骑士传统仍然足以激励我们的士兵以荣誉行动和追求荣誉。
description.text_en: With the return of stable government to Escann, chivalry has made a comeback. Though not as idealistic as it was before the Greentide, our chivalric traditions are still enough to motivate our soldiers to act with honor and seek glory.

description.text: 旧东坎诺传统的恢复也看到了竞赛的复活，以及通过它们解决各方之间的争端。这不仅使升级为直接冲突在我们的贵族中是不可接受的，它也为我们的人民提供了极好的娱乐和适当的恫吓潜在的叛乱者。
description.text_en: The restoration of old Escanni traditions has also seen the resurrection of tourneys, as well as the resolving of disputes between parties through them. Not only does this make escalating to direct conflict socially unacceptable among our nobles, it also provides excellent entertainment for our people and suitable intimidation for would-be rebels.

description.text: 在兽人入侵之前，东坎诺是一片富饶的土地，我们会让它再次富饶！我们要发起一个民族复兴的计划，以使我们的城市恢复昔日的辉煌为目标。
description.text_en: Escann was a rich land before the orcs invaded, and we shall make it rich again! We shall sponsor a program of national rejuvenation with the goal of restoring our cities to their former glory.

description.text: 阿德尼卡王国是「骑士」和骑士精神的诞生地。当阿德尼卡在绿潮中倒下时，那闪耀着荣誉和骑士精神的灯塔就消失了。随着阿德尼卡的再次重塑，我们将奋起实现我们祖先的理想，再次闪耀。带着正直的心，我们的骑士们将重拾昔日的荣耀，对抗不公。
description.text_en: The Kingdom of Adenica was the birthplace of the common ideals of "knights" and chivalry. When Adenica fell during the Greentide, that shining beacon of honour and chivalry was lost. With Adenica reforged again, we will rise to meet the ideals of our forefather and shine once more. With righteous hearts, our knights will reclaim their former glory as they ride against injustice.

description.text: 阿德恩是卡斯特罗斯的长子，祂是荣誉、正义和骑士之神。我们的王国建立之初和现在重建之时，我们的人民完全信奉这些理想。为此，每个男人、女人和孩子都在心中许下这样的誓言：「我们是阿德恩的长矛，是祂所代表的一切。无论我们面对什么邪恶，我们都不会动摇。」
description.text_en: Adean is the first-born son of Castellos, and the god of honour, justice and chivalry. When our kingdom was founded, and now refounded, our people embraced these ideals in their entirety. To this end, every man, woman, and child holds this pledge in their hearts: "We are the spear of Adean and all he stands for. No matter what evil we face, we shall not falter."

description.text: 毫无疑问，我们也认定科琳的飞升成神是应得的，因为她以勇敢的牺牲结束了绿潮。然而，如今试图篡夺摄政王庭的存在也许真的是阿格拉多斯重生并向诸神宣战，而不是飞升的科琳。科琳教徒效忠的并非科琳和她的信仰，而是阿格拉多斯。这种卑鄙的异端邪说和对科琳和摄政王庭的亵渎是不能容忍的。我们必须再次成为阿德恩之矛。
description.text_en: There is no doubt in our minds that Corin deserved her ascent to godhood for her valiant sacrifice ending the Greentide. Yet this attempted usurpation of the Regent Court shows that perhaps it was truly Agrados reborn, not Corin ascendant, that has declared war upon the gods. The Corinites do not pledge themselves to Corin and her beliefs, but to Agrados. This vile heresy and desecration of both Corin's name and the Regent Court as a whole cannot be tolerated. We must be the spear of Adean once more.

description.text: 卡斯塔诺沦陷后，阿德尼卡为了争霸而与其他继业者国家作战。它战斗到最后，直到绿潮毁灭了东坎诺。即使被击倒，它的精神仍在战斗。在烈火，鲜血和钢铁的洗礼下，阿德尼卡重获新生。阿德尼卡人从不害怕为正义而战，他们已经准备好并愿意再次继续战斗。
description.text_en: When Castanor fell, Adenica fought for its sovereignty against the other successor states. It fought to the last as the Greentide brought ruin to Escann. Even when struck down, its spirit continued to fight. And, through fire, blood and steel, Adenica was reforged. Adenners have never feared fighting for what was right and they are ready and willing to continue that fight once more.

description.text: 在阿德尼卡，我们为我们的高尚行为的高标准感到自豪。它是我们文化和社会的核心元素，仅次于我们的信仰。这种高度的荣誉和尊重大大降低了我们官僚机构内部的腐败、勒索和滥用权力的程度。
description.text_en: In Adenica, we pride ourselves on our high standards of honourable conduct. It is a core element of our culture and society, second only to our faith. This high level of honour and respect has led to a vastly lower level of corruption, blackmail and abuse of power within our bureaucracy.

description.text: 要统治阿德尼卡，你必须证明自己值得统治。要做到这一点，一个人必须在登上王位之前获得骑士身份。这是我们王国长期以来的传统，并被证明是非常有用的。我们的骑士王以其骑士精神和高尚的行为闻名于世，是许多统治者和继承人的榜样。这一声誉使我们在国际社会中处于良好地位。
description.text_en: To rule in Adenica, you must prove yourself worthy of rule. To do this, one must obtain knighthood before ascending to the throne. This has been a long standing tradition within our kingdom, and has proven profoundly useful. Our Knight-Kings are known throughout the world for their chivalrous and honourable conduct, and are role models to many rulers and heir-apparents. This reputation has left us in good standing within the global community.

description.text: 我们同时亲近安本纳尔帝国和重生的东坎诺诸国的，这为我们提供了一个独特的机会。我们能够借鉴西坎诺人的规则和创新，以及来自东坎诺诸国的军事专业知识。我们可以利用这一优势保持领先，并确保我们有能力保护那些有需要的人。
description.text_en: Our proximity to both the Empire of Anbennar and the reborn realms of Escann have provided us a unique opportunity. We are able to draw on the regulations and innovations of the Western Cannorians, and the military expertise from the Escanni realms. We can leverage this advantage to stay head of the curve, and ensure our ability to protect those in need.

description.text:
闪光之刃是一把复原的先驱精灵咒刃，在龙醒时中由埃勒卡斯特·巨龙克星用来杀死赤铜龙阿洛斯。此刀以尖锐而闻名，但最著名的是，它闪耀着可以致盲靠近者的光芒——这自古以来一直被用于确定刀锋边区国王的价值。

在面具十年中，人们发现闪光之刃不是普通的剑，正是卡林达尔，一柄以神话中精灵铁匠卡林达尔命名并锻造的先驱咒刃。
description.text_en:
The Gleaming Blade was a greatsword used during the Dragonwake by Elecast Dragonsbane to slay the dragon Alos the Copper. While the blade is known for its sharp vorpal quality, it is most famous for the fact that, once drawn, it shines a light that is capable of blinding those who stare too close - this blinding nature of the blade has been used since time immemorial to determine the worthiness of the Blademarcher kings.

During the Decade of Masks it was discovered that the Gleaming Blade was none other than Calindal, a precursor spellblade named after and forged by the mythological elf-smith Calindal.

description.text: 护刃修会是一支负责守护闪光之刃卡林达尔的修会，确保只有配得上它的人，才能挥舞这把剑并统治刀锋边区。大多数护刃者是由修会接纳的志愿者，有些是因其遭遇不幸而来到这里、有些则只是想为更崇高的使命而战。此外，有少数护刃者被称为目盲大师，他们都是没能通过辉光之刃考验的人。
description.text_en: The Order of the Bladestewards was a monastic order dedicated to protecting (Calindal, the Gleaming Blade) and ensuring that only the worthy may wield it and rule the Blademarches. Most members of the Blade Stewards are volunteers taken in by the Order, whether it be of unfortunate circumstance or simply a warrior looking for a higher cause. However, a small number of the Blade Stewards are known as Blind Masters, who are comprised of individuals who fail the test of the Gleaming Blade.

description.text: 埃勒卡斯特·巨龙克星，王国的创始人，是历史上第一个有记载的屠龙者。我们的缔造者的声誉是无与伦比的，许多人因此而尊敬我们的历史和国家。
description.text_en: Elecast Dragonsbane, the founder of the kingdom, is the first ever-recorded dragonslayer in history. Our founder's renown is unmatched, and many respect our history and nation for it.

description.text: 通过将我们的宗教与君主的加冕相结合，我们可以加强我们的人民对信仰和君主的忠诚。
description.text_en: By integrating our religion with the coronation of the monarch, we can strengthen both the devotion of our people to the faith and to the monarch.

description.text: 卡林达尔就是刀锋边区，刀锋边区就是卡林达尔。任何挥舞着这把闪光之刃的人都是天生的统治者，没有他们，我们什么都不是。
description.text_en: Calindal is Blademarch and Blademarch is Calindal. Any who wield the Gleaming Blade is a worthy ruler by default, and without them: we are nothing.

description.text:
伍利领主在第五次黑火药战争中所作的一首著名的诗，详细描述了刀锋边区的骑士对机械化军团的最后一次冲锋:

「最后一位闪光骠骑兵疾驰而来，
英雄之心熊熊燃烧，闪光之刃急不可待，
他奋勇冲向机械死神：枪炮，
迎来火药的结局，尸骨无存分毫。」

——伍利领主(1853)
description.text_en:
A famous poem by Lord Wooley during the Fifth Blackpowder War, which details the last charge of the Blademarcher cavalry against a legion of mechanical soldiers:

\"the last of the bright hussars came,
with burning hearts and gleaming blade,
onwards to mechanim death: fusillade,
come powder's end: none remained.\"

-Lord Wooley (1853)

description.text_en: The Meritocracy at War and Peace Act was enacted in 1670 during the Witch-Kings Era which reformed the army and government as a whole, replacing all official positions to those of merit not feudal standing, gender or influence.

description.text: 我们王国的象征和皇家庭院的中心装饰品斯科格特林是一棵坚实的黑树，由最初种植在东巨木-埃辛的诅咒之木幼苗生长而成，象征着精灵和东部山谷的人类之间的团结。这棵树的魔力帮助减轻了长期困扰这片土地的诅咒的影响，并让我们的王国在其他国家衰落的地方蓬勃发展。虽然最初的树可能已经在绿潮被摧毁了，但它的遗产将在我们所有人身上继续存在，因为我们的旗帜将再次飘扬在凄苦谷的各个城市。
description.text_en: The symbol of our kingdom and centerpiece of the royal courtyard, the Scoghtrín is a solid black tree grown from a Cursewood sapling first planted in Escin to represent the unity between the elves and men of the eastern Vale. The magics of the tree helped to lessen the effects of the curses that have long plagued this land, and allowed our kingdom to thrive where others have faltered. Though the original may have been destroyed in the Greentide, its legacy lives on in all of us as our banner flies once more over the cities of the Forlorn Vale.

description.text: 我们已统一凄苦谷乃至更远，凭借精灵的教诲、人类的智慧、半精灵的外交手腕，以及法拉内安所有成员的共同努力，我们打造出一支前所未有的军队。昔日伊贝瓦尔与法拉内安各自的军队各有所长，如今它们已凝聚为同一精神，绝不让岁月湮没我们团结所成就的一切。正如精神之合，技艺亦臻统一。当敌军直面法拉内安军团时，刃舞、战争魔法与雷鸣炮火在战场上交织成震撼天地的交响。
description.text_en: We have unified the Vale and more beyond, by the union of Elvish Instruction, Human Ingenuity, Half-Elven diplomacy and all those others who have a place in Farranean, we have built an army that surpasses what came before. The old separate armies of Ibevar and Farranean had their own strengths, but now they have come together in one spirit and shall not let the years forsake what unity between us all has brought. Just as there is the unity of spirit, so too comes the unity of technique. Bladedancing, War Magic and the Thunder of Cannons roar as one great cacophony on the fields where battle is drawn when our enemies face the Farrani Army.

description.text: 诅咒之木是一个很大程度上未被开发的优质木材来源，迷信和山谷中的事件让它们在不受文明影响的情况下茁壮成长，变得富饶。他们长期以来一直为我们提供建造城市和村庄所需的木材，只要我们妥善维护他们，他们就会在我们重建和扩张王国的过程中继续这样做。
description.text_en: The Cursewoods are a largely untapped source of quality lumber, the superstitions and happenings of the Vale allowing them to grow thick and rich, untouched by civilization. They've long supplied the timber required to build our cities and villages, and so long as we maintain them properly they will continue to do so as we rebuild and expand the kingdom.

description.text:
白色瘟疫，以及它带来的不死部落，摧毁了法拉内安这个年轻的王国。为了生存，我们建造了重兵把守的城镇，名为凯斯安，在遭受攻击时为我们的人民提供住所。当尘埃落定，我们被允许返回家园时，我们的许多人留在凯斯安的围墙内，为未来发生危机或与伊贝瓦尔的战争做好准备。多亏了他们，我们的许多人民才得以逃离绿潮，他们的城墙只支撑了足够长的时间，让他们逃到更安全的地方。

随着我们王国的恢复，凯斯安也将重新出现，准备好保卫我们对抗任何诸神让我们的对抗的事物。
description.text_en:
The White Pestilence, and the undead hordes it brought, ravaged the young kingdom of Farraneán. To survive we constructed heavily fortified towns known as Caseán to house our people during attacks. When the dust settled and we were allowed to return to our homes, many of our people stayed within the walls of these Caseán, maintaining them in anticipation of future crises or war with Ibevar. It was due to them that many of our people were able to escape from the Greentide, their walls holding just long enough for them to flee to safer lands.

With our kingdom restored the Caseáns shall be repopulated as well, ready to defend us against whatever the gods decide to send our way.

description.text: 阿德蕾西娅骑士团曾经誓言守卫凄苦谷与帝国，抵御科乌里亚领域的侵蚀，并在绿潮来袭时成为这席卷大陆的灾厄中首批难民的庇护之地。如今他们的时代已然落幕，他们的权力已升临至法拉内安王权之下的分支之一。但这并不是悲剧，因为他们仍作为我们境内的骑士团，延续自己的存在，而他们世俗权威的终结只是因为阿德蕾西娅的古老誓约与每位骑士的誓言已然实现。如今他们立下新的誓言——效忠于法拉内安的君主、凄苦谷与东坎诺的人民，昔日在安本纳尔帝国履行的使命已经终结。他们曾在东坎诺问题上产生分歧，如今凭借我们无尽的耐心，东坎诺已使他们彻底重归完整。
description.text_en: The Orda Aldresia once guarded the Vale and the Empire both against the encroachment of the Corvurian realm, and then when the Greentide came were one of the first refuges for those fleeing the destruction that was wrought upon the continent. Their time is now over, their authority sublimated to that of the Farrani Crown. But this is not a tragic circumstance, for they continue as an order within our realm and their temporal authority ends only because the old promise of Aldresia and the oaths all knight gave stands fulfilled. They have new oaths now, to the Monarchs of Farranean and to the people of the Vale and Escann where once they served the Empire of Anbennar at their own peril. They split on the issue of Escann, but now Escann has mended them in full with our boundless patience.

description.text: 法拉内安的许多建立者都来自埃斯玛里亚，他们带来了狂欢和庆祝的传统。这一年最令人期待的庆祝活动是一年一度的舞会，在穿过东巨木埃辛的科高鲁伊斯河上停泊着几十艘驳船。平民在河边庆祝并兜售小饰品，而富有的贵族、商人和来访的显贵则在船上聚会和交谈。庆祝活动通常在银视月的第一周举行，此时斯科格特林的鲜花盛开，皇家花园的芬芳弥漫整个城市。
description.text_en: Many of Farraneán's founders came from Esmaria, and they brought with them traditions of revelry and festivities. The most anticipated celebration of the year is the annual Ball held on several dozen barges moored in the Cogaulúis river as it runs through Escin. Commoners celebrate and peddle trinkets along the riverbank while wealthy nobles, merchants, and visiting dignitaries party and converse on the vessels. The celebrations are typically held during the first week of Silversight, as the Scoghtrín blooms and the fragrance of the royal gardens wafts over the city.

description.text: 斯科格特林如今矗立在那里，反射着阳光，即便在夜间也闪烁着微弱的光芒。它作为国家的象征，随时都能让人感受到它的存在。纵使在理应不可能的时刻，人们仍总觉得自己能依稀看见这座承载着国家希望与梦想的容器。这显然是魔法的杰作，但与将全体人民凝聚于这一共同体验相比，它并不在意那些炫耀力量的浮华表演。
description.text_en: The Scogtrin stands now, reflecting the Sun and shining dimly even at night. It stands as a symbol of the nation that can be felt at any time. Across the realm even when it should be impossible, people always feel they can just about see the faint outline of this receptacle of the nation’s hopes and dreams. Such a thing is clearly the work of magic, but it cares little for ostentatious displays of might compared to just bringing all the people together with this shared experience.

description.text_en: Farraneán has always been a diverse land, a kingdom where elves and men thrived alongside each other as equals and compatriots, forging our unique culture and strategies. From our human roots we take chivalry and horsemanship, our knights charging into battle without fear or worry. From our elven roots we take their skill with the bow, archers supporting the horseman's charge from afar with excellent precision. It is through this fusion of strengths and tactics that Farraneán has survived throughout the centuries, and it will allow us to stand on our own for many more.

description.text: 我们的王国很有可能在短短几十年内完全沦陷，如果不是阿德蕾西娅女士和她的贵族圣战军及时到来的话。他们的行动拯救了王国和我们的人民，征服了折磨我们的贪婪的死者。作为对他们服务和勇敢的回报，法拉内安贵族们长期以来的传统就是送他们年幼的孩子加入他们的骑士团，训练自己保护弱者同时也充当我们的使者，在安本纳尔的宫庭上传播善意，确保法拉内安的名字在坎诺得到尊重和信任。
description.text_en: Our kingdom very well may have fallen completely within a few short decades if not for the timely arrival of Lady Aldresia and her noble crusaders. Their actions saved the kingdom and our people, vanquishing the ravenous dead that tormented us. In return for their service and bravery, it has been a long standing tradition for Farrani nobles to send their younger children to join their order, training themselves to defend the weak while also acting as our emissaries, spreading goodwill throughout the courts of Anbennar and ensuring the name of Farraneán is respected and trusted across Cannor.

description.text:
法拉内安曾两次面临灾难，我们也两次从确定无疑的毁灭中恢复过来。即使是神圣的斯科格特林的毁灭，虽然令人难以置信的悲剧，对我们来说也是一个小挫折，因为她的孩子现在骄傲地站在法兰堡皇宫的庭院里。凯斯安再次守护着我们的村庄和乡镇，而在森林里，我们的男男女女们努力工作，为前哨谷提供木材。

长期以来，凄苦谷一直是一个很少有人涉足的地方，因为人们害怕诅咒和暗影生物。但对我们来说，她是我们的家，我们的摇篮和壁炉，在那里我们可以和谐发展。斯科格特林只要开花，法拉内安就会绽放。
description.text_en:
Twice Farraneán has faced catastrophe, and twice we have risen back from sure ruination. Even the destruction of the venerable Scoghtrín was, though incredibly tragic, but a minor setback for us, as her young child now stands proud in the courtyard of Arca Farran, the royal palace. The Caseáns once again guard our villages and townships, while in the woods our men and women work hard to supply timber to the Whistlevale.

The Forlorn Vale has long been a place few tread, fearful of curses and shadowy creatures. But to us, she is home, our cradle and hearth, where we may prosper in harmony. For so long as the Scoghtrín blooms, Farraneán shall blossom.

description.text: 旧战神阿格拉多斯以其凶猛的愤怒和对敌人不屈不挠的打击而闻名，但科琳却不这么看。她认为使用她的力量不仅可以打击敌人，而且同样可以用来保护她的信徒，在这一点上没有任何事件可以与卡斯托纳斯之战相比，当时科琳举起盾牌，保护洛萨恩·蓝牙免遭科尔古斯·杜坎森本人的致命一击，她知道这样做会使她暴露在科尔古斯的脱手攻击中。她接受了自己的使命，利用这一防御时刻还以颜色，以自己的生命为代价杀死了科尔古斯，彻底结束了绿潮。
description.text_en: The old god of war Agrados was known for his ferocious rage and unyielding blows against his enemies, but Corin saw differently. She saw equal merit in using her powers not only to strike at her foes, but to use them to protect her faithful just the same - no such event can be compared to the Battle of Castonath when Corin raised her shield to defend Lothane Bluetusk from a killing blow by Korgus Dookanson himself, knowing that it would leave her exposed to Korgus' off-hand attack. Accepting her purpose, she used this moment of defense to return the favour and slew Korgus at the cost of her life, ending the Greentide once and for all.

description.text: 洛萨恩·蓝牙是科琳的忠实朋友和伙伴，也是科琳塔尔的第一位大团长。当科琳的理想开始建立科琳塔尔时，是洛萨恩的工作将团队组织成一个合法的力量。
description.text_en: Lothane Bluetusk was a loyal friend and companion of Corin and the first Grandmaster of the Corintar. While Corin's ideals started the Corintar, it was Lothane's work that organized the order into a legitimate force.

description.text: 科琳。洛萨恩·蓝牙。绞架峰的多米尼克。埃勒达斯·席尔乌里翁。所有这些名字和其他科琳团里的十几个名字已经成为坎诺所有地区家喻户晓的名字。作为他们的后继者，我们有很长的路要走，但他们的英雄主义和遗产永远不会离开我们。
description.text_en: Corin. Lothane Bluetusk. Dominic of Gallowspeak. Eledas Silurion. All of these names and a dozen more of Corin's Circle have become household names across all of Cannor. We as their successors have big shoes to fill, but their heroism and legacy will never leave us.

description.text: 不像其他人，我们没有高贵的血统，也没有传奇的祖先。我们只是来自十几个种族和文化的诚实的男人和女人，他们走到一起，因为我们相信某件事和某个人——科琳。让我们建立一个以理想为基础的新秩序，而不是以出身为基础！
description.text_en: Unlike others, we can claim no exalted lineage nor storied ancestry. We are merely honest men and women from a dozen races and cultures who came together because we believed in something and someone- Corin. Let us promote a new order based on ideals, not origins!

description.text:
「没有行动的善行毫无意义，

没有行动，邪恶的根源就会滋生。

我们的盾牌用以护卫，我们的剑用以打击，

而清除邪恶意味着拯救世界」

——科琳信条
description.text_en:
"For goodness without action means nothing,

And from nothing, the roots of evil will fester,

For our shields protect, and our swords strike true,

And evil purged means a world saved."

-Corinite Creed

description.text: 随着越来越多的人皈依科琳教，越来越多的人感到她的意志必须传播到所有人的热情。这个不断壮大的团体被称为科琳教圣战军，他们在坎诺甚至安本纳尔战斗希望给世界带来正义。
description.text_en: As more and more people were converted to the Corinite faith, more and more people felt the zeal that her will must be spread across all. This ever-growing group were known as the Corinite Crusaders, and warred across Cannor and even Anbennar itself hoping to bring justice to world.

description.text: 当旧的科琳塔尔被解散，国家事务由科琳信仰圣战军控制时，一个由温和的科琳塔尔人组成的新分裂团体成立了一个半秘密的社团，叫做新科琳塔尔。这些成员在世界各地工作，秘密地确保科琳的自由、正义和人类美好的理想得到支持，甚至超越了科琳塔尔的边界。
description.text_en: When the old Corintar was disbanded and the affairs of the state were under control of the Corinite Crusaders, a new splinter group consisting of moderate Corinites formed a semi-secret society called the New Corintar. These members worked all across the world to secretly ensure that Corin's ideals of freedom, justice and good of man were upheld even beyond the borders of the Corintari state.

effects.display: 可以招募女性将领：允许

description.text:
在龙醒期间，马尔罗德部落为了躲避「入侵者」戈德拉克的怒火，与罗希本和威克斯兄弟一起向南逃亡，但加韦德军阀并未就此罢休。但当三大部落在山峦堡与达梅里亚守卫要塞的盟友一起被加韦德人追上时，他们做出了最后的抵抗。他们的胜利迫使加韦德军队撤退，达梅里亚给予他们土地作为奖赏。虽然威克斯人接受了奖赏，但伟大的国王马尔心中却有不同的计划。他带领他的人民向西，穿过科巴尔王国，前往卡斯塔诺的土地，那里最近刚被龙的狂怒摧毁。科巴尔人嘲笑他的计划，但国王毫不动摇，他对那些怀疑者说：

「被闪电劈倒的树不会再被劈第二次！」

这句话成为了马尔罗德精神的化身：一个如此大胆的民族，竟然在自己的暴风眼中寻求避风港。无论是在灾难中还是在战斗中，马尔罗德人都坚定不移，就像马尔王一样。
description.text_en:
During the Dragonwake, the Marrodic tribe fled south alongside their Rohibonic and Wexonard brethren to escape the wrath of Godrac the Invader, but the Gawedi Warlord did not relent. But when the Three Tribes were caught at Bal Hyl, alongside allies of convenience in the Damerian garrison of the citadel, they made a last stand. The ensuing victory pushed the Gawedi forces back, and the Damerian offered them land as a reward, and while the Wexonards accepted, the great king Marr had different plans in mind. He directed his people east, through the Korbarid kingdom to the lands of Castanor, recently ruined by the fury of dragons. The Korbarids mocked his plan, but the king was unwavering, and to those who doubted, he said:

“A tree felled by lightning shan't be struck twice!”

This phrase became the embodiment of the Marrodic spirit: a people so bold they seek refuge from the storm within its own eye. Be it during catastrophes or in battle, the Marrodics are steadfast and unwavering, just as King Marr was.

description.text:
很久以前，孤独之门领地被遗弃，由于隧道被摧毁以抵御潜伏在深渊中的怪物，领地与蛇脊山脉的联系被切断。492年，当马尔罗德人到达领地时，他们发现这里是一片空旷的废墟，适合他们定居和重建。
于是，马尔罗德人开始了漫长的重建工作，他们重建了领地；这一过程花费了天文数字的黄金，主要是为了丰厚地奖励「大帝」乌尔里克三世为完成这一工程而雇佣的工匠。这是一个艰巨的过程，但在549年，他们成功地完全重建了第一层，王室很快就搬进了这里。大多数人留在谷地，主要从事农民和牧羊人的工作，而孤独之门则发展成为了马尔谷城。

它的大厅和住宅根据人类的体型进行了调整，墙壁上装饰着挂毯和艾伦雕刻，锻造厂生产出大量的长剑和链甲。这里不再是孤独之门，而是马尔霍德，马尔罗德人是谷地的领主。
description.text_en:
Long ago, the hold of Ânumdihr was abandoned, severed from the Serpentspine as the tunnels were destroyed to hold off the monsters lurking in the deep. When the Marrodics reached the hold in 492, they found an empty ruin suitable for their people to settle and rebuild.
So began a long reconstruction effort in which the Marrodics rebuilt the hold; this process cost an astronomical amount of gold, mostly to handsomely reward the dwarven artisans Ulric III ‘the Great’ hired to finish the project. It was an arduous process, but in 549 they managed to fully rebuild the first level, the royal court moving into it soon after. While most remained within the Vale to work mainly as farmers and shepherds, Ânumdihr grew into the city of the Marrvale.

Its halls and homes were adjusted for human size, its walls adorned with tapestries and engraving of Alenic make, and the forges produced vast quantities of longswords and chainmail. No longer was this Ânumdihr, this was Marrhold, and the Marrodics were the Lords of the Vale.

name.text_en: The Hold of the Griffon King

description.text:
传说中，当马尔罗德人定居在马尔谷及其巨大但破旧废弃的矮人领地时，他们遭到了从山中降下的长着翅膀的可怕生物的袭击。由于许多人在这些袭击中非死即伤，马尔国王派他的儿子乌尔里克去面对这些怪物。据说，乌尔里克王子爬上了蛇脊山脉的高处，到达了山顶的狮鹫巢穴。在那里，他与狮鹫战斗了好几个小时，最终战胜了这些对他的人民构成威胁的怪物。不过，他还是放过了它们的蛋，并在下山时带走了许多。

随着时间的推移，这些狮鹫逐渐成长为强大的坐骑，并被授予马尔国王最优秀的战士，乌尔里克就是骑在他的狮鹫「雷霆之骥」上第一位狮鹫骑士。几个世纪以来，狮鹫骑士在马尔罗德社会中占据了主导地位，只有最高级别的贵族才能担任这一职位，狮鹫的繁殖和饲养受到了高度的保护和管理。

虽然有人说我们对狮鹫骑士的依赖是愚蠢的，因为我们的社会结构僵化，而且这些精锐部队的数量很少，但即使在龙醒之后，即便是最强大的坎诺领主也害怕看到天空中移动的东西，这是有原因的。
description.text_en:
Legend has it that as the Marrodics settled the Marrvale and its great, though dilapidated and abandoned Dwarven hold, they were set upon by terrifying winged creatures that would descend from the mountains. With many either dying or being wounded by these attacks, King Marr sent his son, Ulric, to face these monsters. It is said Prince Ulric climbed high into the Serpentspine Mountains, reaching the nest of the griffons at the top. There, he battled them for many hours, eventually vanquishing the threat to his people. Once he had, however, he chose to spare their eggs, taking many with him on his descent.

In time, these griffons would grow into mighty steeds granted to King Marr’s finest warriors, with Ulric as the first Griffon Rider atop his steed, ‘Thundersteed’. Over the centuries, the Griffon Knights would come to dominate Marrodic society, the position given only to the highest ranking nobles, with the breeding and rearing of the steeds being a highly protected and regulated affair.

While some call our reliance on them foolish, citing our rigid social structure and low number of these elite troops, there is a reason why even after the Dragonwake, even the mightiest lords of Cannor dread the sight of something moving in the skies.

description.text:
空中比武是狮鹫骑士训练的支柱之一。这一传统可以追溯到503年，当时乌尔里克一世挑选了第一批狮鹫骑士。从那时起，比武经历了多次演变，先是纯粹的军事演习，然后是贵族比武，但直到1386年才正式将两者结合起来。

每年都会在不同的地点和时间举行两种不同的比武。
一种是传统的训练，在冬季举行，地点在马尔霍德的深山中，很少有旁观者能一睹其风采。这种训练被认为是最艰苦的，是在极度的风雪中进行的。
第二项活动是在狮鹫门举行的盛大夏日庆典，任何马尔霍德市民均可参观，狮鹫骑士们身着华丽的游行服饰，白色长披风随风飘扬。这是唯一能在同一地点看到这么多狮鹫的机会，也是著名狮鹫骑士空中舞蹈的盛会。
description.text_en:
Aerial jousting is one of the pillars of a Griffon-Knight’s training. This tradition dates back to the year 503, when Ulric I chose the first Griffon-Knights. Since then the practice has evolved many times, first as a purely military drill, then as a noble tournament, but it was only in 1386 where both practices were officially conjoined.

Two different jousts are hosted each year in different locations and times.
One is the traditional course of training, occurring in winter deep within the mountains above Marrhold, with scant few onlookers having ever caught a glimpse of this event. This training is reputed to be most arduous, carried out in extreme wind and snow.
The second is a grand summer festival held in Griffonsgate, open to any citizen of Marrhold, in which Griffon-Knights show off in magnificent parade attire with long white cloaks floating in the wind. This event is famed for being the only opportunity to see so many griffons in the same place and for the aerial choreographies of renowned Griffon-Knights.

description.text:
与他的祖父不同，「年轻者」格里夫是一位技艺高超的狮鹫骑手，拥有最敏锐的头脑。事实上，大多数人都说，正是由于他的努力，马尔霍德才得以在绿潮结束、科尔古斯战死之后，在东坎诺获得了稳固的地位。在卡斯托纳斯之战中，他不顾命令，奋不顾身地帮助科琳，最终成为了决定性的因素之一，他是一位技艺精湛的战士、才华横溢的指挥官，也是鼓舞人心的存在。

年轻的格里夫八世继承王位后，决定重振狮鹫骑士团，允许下层贵族甚至是杰出的平民获得狮鹫。虽然这是一项有争议的措施，但它的成功使15世纪上半叶日渐式微的骑士价值观得以复兴，新改革的狮鹫骑士团最终站在了开垦东坎诺的最前沿。
description.text_en:
Unlike his grandfather, Gryf ‘the Young’ was a very skilled griffon rider gifted with a most astute mind. Indeed, most say that it was thanks to his efforts that Marrhold managed to obtain a secure position in Escann following the breaking of the Greentide and Korgus’ death. This was only amplified by his decision to defy his orders and fight when he sallied forth to help Corin during the battle of Castonath and ended up being one of the decisive factors as a skilled fighter, talented commander, and inspiring presence.

When he inherited the throne, Gryf VIII ‘the Young’ decided to revitalize the Griffon-Knights by allowing the lower nobility and even distinguished commoners to obtain a griffon. While this was a controversial measure, its success led to a renaissance of the chivalric values that had been dwindling during the first half of the 15th century, and the newly reformed Griffon-Knights ended up at the forefront of the reclamation of Escann.

description.text:
为了确保王国的安全，一代又一代的国王加固了马尔谷，从而形成了一个坚固的防御工事系统，能够抵御和击退大多数入侵者。在长期围困的情况下，我们可以通过秘密通道保持补给和人员。如果堡垒失守，敌人就会深入多层防御工事系统，并利用秘密通道骚扰他们的补给；最终，敌人身后就会出现一个死亡陷阱，因为任何被攻占的堡垒都会被马尔罗德人夺回，将敌人隔离在敌对堡垒和被困通道的海洋中。
这个堡垒阵被一名敌军将领昵称为「马尔谷死亡之环」，他的军队被这个堡垒阵一分为二，全军覆没。

因此，马尔谷从未被攻破过。几个世纪以来，没有人能够到达这里；无论是尼奇默还是杜坎森，虽然马尔霍德曾臣服于卡米尔，但即使是他也没有试图围攻这里，这也是马尔罗德人引以为豪的地方。
description.text_en:
To ensure the safety of the kingdom, generation after generation of kings fortified the Marrvale, resulting in a sturdy system of fortifications able to resist and repel most invaders. In the event of a prolonged siege, secret passes allow us to keep them supplied and manned. If a fort were to fall, the enemy would be allowed deeper in the multi-layered fortification system and their supplies harassed using the secret passages; ultimately, a deathly trap would close behind the enemies as any fort taken would be retaken by the Marrodics, isolating the enemies in a sea of hostile forts and trapped passages.
This formation of forts was nicknamed “The Death Ring of Marrvale” by an enemy general that had its army cut in two and decimated by the formation.

As such, the Marrhold was unbroken. None managed to reach it for centuries; neither Nichmer, Dookanson, and though Marrhold submitted to Camir, not even he tried to besiege the hold, a source of great pride for the Marrodics.

description.text:
狮鹫骑士的独特之处在于他们将机动性和速度融为一体的能力，骑士们主要专注于震慑战术。但是，随着奇械术的崛起，战争发生了翻天覆地的变化，狮鹫骑士的效率和作用也慢慢减弱。国王乌尔里克十七世·马尔不忍心看到许多人认为是马尔霍德的力量沦为简单的外来宠物；因此，他对我们当地的奇械术士进行了大量投资，委托他们开发武器，使狮鹫骑士无论在什么条件下都能在空中进行攻击。奇械术士们迅速开展工作，既耗尽了王国的国库，又按要求完成了任务。
因此，1757年，狮鹫骑士的新进化版诞生了，这是一种从空中投掷重型炸药的高空飞行编队。他们被称为狮鹫轰炸者中队，很快取代了传统的狮鹫骑士。轰炸者中队具有极强的破坏力，但要部署得当，它们必须能够进行弹药补给，而且不能完全暴露在来袭的炮火之下，因为狮鹫在俯冲和爬升过程中都很容易受到炮弹和子弹的攻击。
description.text_en:
What made the Griffon-Knights unique was their ability to meld both mobility and speed, and the knights primarily focused on shock and awe tactics. But, with the rise of artificers, warfare changed drastically, slowly rendering the Griffon-Knights less efficient and relevant. King Ulric XVII Marr could not bear to see what many believe to be Marrhold’s strength be relegated to a simple exotic pet; as such, he invested greatly in our local artificers, commissioning them to develop weapons enabling the Griffon-Knights to attack while remaining airborne, whatever the conditions. The artificers worked quickly,both draining the treasury of the kingdom and creating what was required of them.
As such, in 1757, the new evolution of the Griffon-Knights was created, a high-flying formation dropping weighted explosives from the heavens. Known as the Griffon Bombardier Squadron, they quickly replaced the traditional Griffon-Knights. The Bombardier Squadron were devastatingly effective, but to be deployed properly, they had to be able to resupply with ammunition and not be completely exposed to incoming fire, for griffons remained vulnerable to shot and shell during both the dive and during the climb after.
